description:
Create a new email template in Odoo CRM for following up on opportunities. 

1. Enable Developer Mode (Settings).
2. Navigate to Settings > Technical > Email > Templates.
3. Create a new template with the following details:
   - Template Name: 'Opportunity Follow-Up'
   - Applies to (Model): Lead/Opportunity (crm.lead)
   - Subject: 'Following up: {{ object.name }}'
   - Email Body (HTML): Must include the following dynamic placeholders and text:
     - A greeting using the partner's name: {{ object.partner_id.name }}
     - A reference to the opportunity name: {{ object.name }}
     - The phrase: 'Thank you for your interest'
     - A closing: 'Best regards'

Save the template once configured.
